generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection..

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in his name should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 Achieved in at least two financial years a minimum average financial turnover (in all classes of Consultancy Services works only) of Rs.42.04 Lakhs

Specific experience of the consultants related to the Assignment : Should have experience in DGPS Survey for fixing of boundary stones and geo-referencing the area (Atleast 90% Completed) as prime contractor within previous five years

The Consultants Company (herein after referred to as the consultant) should be registered with companies. Department as Category-I & above consultant and should have a minimum of 03 years of Experience as a Consultants Company conducting similar assignments. Certificate of Registration should be furnished. (Consultancy and Research)

The approach and methodology shall clearly define the Consultants approach to complete the assignment within the time frame and methodology adopted. Adequacy of the proposed work plan and methodology in responding to the terms of reference (TOR).

The Consultants Company should have and deploy the following key personnel man power for the assignment. Bio data of individual key personnel signed by the individual member shall be furnished. (General Qualifications, Adequacy for the project, Experience in region & language of key personal should be furnished)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Banker Details for reference
Above Staff has to be in the until work completes and may extend whenever there is need from Chief Research Officer, Coastal Engineering Division, KR Sagara & NWDA Officials
Equipment: Ownership of Instruments Required: DGPS -4 No with supporting software

For assignments on a staff-time basis, the estimated number of key professional staff-months is given in the Data Sheet. The proposal shall, however, be based on the number of key professional staff-months estimated by the firm
It is desirable that the majority of the key professional staff proposed be permanent employees of the firm or have an extended and stable working relation with it
Proposed key professional staff must have at least the experience indicated in the Data Sheet
Alternative key professional staff shall not be proposed and only one curriculum vitae (CV) may be submitted for each position

Reports to be issued by the consultants as part of this assignment must be in the language specified in the Data Sheet. It is desirable that the firms personnel have a working knowledge of the Clients official language.

A brief description of the firms organisation and an outline of recent experience on assignments (Section 3B) of a similar nature. For each assignment, the outline should indicate, inter alia, the profiles and names of the staff provided, duration of the assignment, contract amount, and firms involvement
A description of the methodology and work plan for performing the assignment (Section 3D).
The list of the proposed staff team by speciality, the tasks that would be assigned to each staff team member, and their timing (Section 3E).

CVs recently signed by the proposed key professional staff and the authorized representative submitting the proposal (Section 3F). Key information should include number of years working for the firm/ reputed institute and degree of responsibility held in various assignments as indicated in section 3F

Estimates of the total staff effort (professional and support staff: staff time) to be provided to carry out the Assignment, supported by bar chart diagrams showing the time proposed for each key professional staff team members. (Sections 3E and 3G)
Any additional information requested in the Data Sheet
